question: Can you calculate the median from the highest season goals of each team?
sql:
WITH team_season_goals AS (
  SELECT 
    season,
    home_team AS team,
    SUM(home_team_goal) AS goals
  FROM match_view
  GROUP BY season, home_team
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 
    season,
    away_team AS team,
    SUM(away_team_goal) AS goals
  FROM match_view
  GROUP BY season, away_team
),
team_season_totals AS (
  SELECT season, team, SUM(goals) AS total_goals
  FROM team_season_goals
  GROUP BY season, team
),
highest_season_goals AS (
  SELECT team, MAX(total_goals) AS highest_goals
  FROM team_season_totals
  GROUP BY team
)
SELECT PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY highest_goals) AS median_highest_goals
FROM highest_season_goals
